name: mern-scraper
description: Root orchestration scripts for mern-scraper (infra, server, client).

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npx --prefix server playwright install chromium && npm install --prefix client && node scripts/ensure-env.js
scripts.redis:flush: docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli FLUSHALL
scripts.dev: npm run infra && concurrently -k -n API,WORKER,CLIENT -c blue,magenta,green "wait-on tcp:27017 tcp:6379 && npm run api --prefix server" "wait-on tcp:27017 tcp:6379 && npm run worker --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run infra && wait-on tcp:6379 && npm run redis:flush && npm run dev
